checks.rule: Environment Agency Time Stamped DTM is an archive of raster elevation surveys across England.
Site-specific LIDAR surveys have been carried out since 1998.
Some areas have been surveyed multiple times.
Available resolutions include 25 cm, 50 cm, 1 m and 2 m depending on project requirements.
DTM generation removes surface objects to model terrain.
Data are downloadable as GeoTIFF rasters in 5 km zip files.
Elevations are referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn.
Tiles are aligned to the OS Grid.
The archive states vertical accuracy of ±15 cm RMSE.
Prefer the newest appropriate time-stamped survey when temporal mismatch could change terrain.
Record survey resolution and date per candidate; do not mix resolutions/dates without provenance.
